title: Yeltsin asks about his trip 'up there'

tellings.quote: "It's been reported to me that you've been up there."

plain: In the Kremlin in the late 1990s, Boris Yeltsin asked a regional leader about his reported trip aboard an alien craft, saying: "It's been reported to me that you've been up there." The leader in question, Kiran Ilum Xenov, then president of one of Russia's republics, tells Michels this himself, as the man who says he was taken by aliens in 1997. If true, it would mean the claim reached the very top of the Russian state.
